summary: 7-year-old boy separated from his family while hiking the Sand Dunes ~5:30 p.m., barefoot and wearing only a heavy jacket; AVSAR + NPS rangers + Alamosa County SO searched until ~midnight and regrouped for a dawn search with air support; found near the Oasis on Hwy 150 by a Colorado State Trooper, unharmed, taken to hospital as a precaution.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / NPS / Alamosa County SO
notes: Date = mission date; child found at dawn March 9, 2015. Run 492 merge: CPR (opened) reports the boy as 6 years old vs AVSAR's 7; found Monday March 9 by a CSP trooper walking down the road. Run 827 merge: Backpacker (parent-opened) corroborates same incident (child found walking near highway by state trooper, released from hospital).
